actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Miro action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Miro connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: attach_tag_to_item
actions.title: Attach tag to item
actions.description: Attach tag to item in Miro
actions.help: Attaches a tag to a board item. Supported for cards and sticky notes only.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: item_id
input.label: Item ID
input.hint: Enter the ID of the board item.

input.name: tag_id
input.label: Tag ID
input.hint: Enter the ID of the tag. Use the List board tags action to find tag IDs.

actions.name: copy_board_v2
actions.title: Copy existing board
actions.description: Copy an existing board in Miro
actions.help: Creates a new board by copying an existing one. Provide the source board and optional name, description, and sharing policy.

input.name: name
input.label: Title
input.hint: Name of the new board. Defaults to Copy of the original board title if left blank.

input.name: description
input.label: Description
input.hint: Description of the new board. Defaults to the original board description if left blank.

input.name: teamId
input.label: Team ID
input.hint: ID of the team to create the copied board in. Defaults to the authenticated user's default team.

properties.name: access
properties.label: Access by link
properties.hint: Access to the board by link.

properties.name: teamAccess
properties.label: Access by team
properties.hint: Team access to the board.

properties.name: inviteToAccountAndBoardLinkAccess
properties.label: Invite to account and board link access

actions.name: create_board_v2
actions.title: Create board
actions.help: Creates a new board in Miro. Provide a name and optional description.

input.name: name
input.label: Title
input.hint: Board title. Defaults to Untitled if left blank.

input.name: description
input.label: Description
input.hint: Board description.

input.name: teamId
input.label: Team ID
input.hint: ID of the team to create the board in. Defaults to the authenticated user's default team.

input.name: projectId
input.label: Project ID
input.hint: ID of the project to assign this board to.

properties.name: access
properties.label: Access by link
properties.hint: Access to the board by link.

properties.name: teamAccess
properties.label: Access by team
properties.hint: Team access to the board.

properties.name: inviteToAccountAndBoardLinkAccess
properties.label: Invite to account and board link access

actions.name: create_card_widget_v2
actions.title: Create a card widget on board
actions.description: Create a card widget on board in Miro
actions.help: Creates a card on the specified board using the Miro v2 API. Supports due date, assignee, frame placement, tags, position, and geometry.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Parent frame
input.hint: Shows up to 50 frames alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter frame ID directly.

properties.name: title
properties.label: Card title
properties.hint: Card title. Max 6000 symbols.

properties.name: link
properties.label: Title link
properties.hint: URL to embed in the card title as a clickable link.

properties.name: description
properties.label: Card description
properties.hint: Card description. Opens on double-click.

properties.name: dueDate
properties.label: Card due date
properties.hint: Due date for the card.

properties.name: assigneeId
properties.label: Assignee ID
properties.hint: ID of the user to assign to this card.

properties.name: cardTheme
properties.label: Card border color
properties.hint: Hex color for the card border (e.g. #2399f3 ).

properties.name: width
properties.label: Width
properties.hint: Width in pixels.

properties.name: height
properties.label: Height
properties.hint: Height in pixels.

properties.name: rotation
properties.label: Rotation
properties.hint: Rotation in degrees. Positive = clockwise.

input.name: tag_ids
input.label: Tag IDs
input.hint: List of tag IDs to attach to this item. Replaces all existing tags. Maximum 8 tags. Use the List board tags action to find tag IDs.

actions.name: create_sticky_note
actions.title: Create sticky note
actions.help: Creates a sticky note on the specified board. Optionally place it in a frame and attach tags after creation.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Parent frame
input.hint: Shows up to 50 frames alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter frame ID directly.

properties.name: content
properties.label: Content
properties.hint: Text content of the sticky note. Supports basic HTML.

properties.name: fillColor
properties.label: Fill color
properties.hint: Defaults to light_yellow .

properties.name: textAlign
properties.label: Text align
properties.hint: Horizontal text alignment.

properties.name: textAlignVertical
properties.label: Text align vertical
properties.hint: Vertical text alignment.

input.name: tag_ids
input.label: Tag IDs
input.hint: List of tag IDs to attach to this item. Replaces all existing tags. Maximum 8 tags. Use the List board tags action to find tag IDs.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.title: Create tag
actions.help: Creates a new tag on the specified board with a title and optional fill color.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: title
input.label: Tag title
input.hint: Title of the tag. Maximum 120 characters.

input.name: fillColor
input.label: Fill color
input.hint: Fill color for the tag label. Defaults to red .

actions.name: create_text_item
actions.title: Create text item
actions.help: Creates a text item on the specified board. Supports HTML content and style customization.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Parent frame
input.hint: Shows up to 50 frames alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter frame ID directly.

properties.name: content
properties.label: Content
properties.hint: Text content. Supports basic HTML formatting.

properties.name: color
properties.label: Text color
properties.hint: Hex color for text (e.g. #1a1a1a ). Note: inline HTML color styles in content override this value.

properties.name: fillColor
properties.label: Fill color
properties.hint: Hex color for the background (e.g. #ffffff ).

properties.name: fillOpacity
properties.label: Fill opacity
properties.hint: Background opacity. Value between 0.0 (transparent) and 1.0 (opaque).

properties.name: fontSize
properties.label: Font size
properties.hint: Font size in dp (e.g. 14 ). Supported range: 10–288.

properties.name: textAlign
properties.label: Text align
properties.hint: Horizontal text alignment.

properties.name: rotation
properties.label: Rotation
properties.hint: Rotation angle in degrees. Positive = clockwise, negative = counterclockwise.

actions.name: detach_tag_from_item

input.name: board_id

actions.name: list_board_items
actions.title: List board items
actions.help: Returns items on the specified board. Filter by item type (sticky note, card, text, etc.). Supports cursor-based pagination.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

input.name: parent_item_id
input.label: Parent frame
input.hint: Return only items inside this frame. Shows up to 50 frames alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter frame ID directly.

input.name: type
input.label: Item type
input.hint: Filter items by type. Leave blank to return all item types.

properties.name: limit
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of results to return per page. Maximum 50.

properties.name: cursor
properties.label: Cursor
properties.hint: Copy the Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

actions.name: list_board_tags
actions.title: List board tags
actions.help: Returns all tags defined on the specified board. Supports pagination via offset.

input.name: board_id
input.label: Board
input.hint: Shows up to 50 boards alphabetically. If not listed, use toggle to enter board ID directly.

properties.name: limit
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 20 when not provided. Maximum 50.

properties.name: offset
properties.label: Offset
properties.hint: Number of results to skip. Copy from a previous response to fetch the next page.

actions.name: search_boards
actions.title: Search boards
actions.help: Returns boards you have access to. Filter by name using the search query. Supports pagination via offset.

input.name: query
input.label: Search query
input.hint: Search boards by name or description. Ignored when Team ID or Project ID is provided. Can be combined with Owner to narrow results.

input.name: owner
input.label: Owner
input.hint: Filter boards by owner ID (e.g. 3074457353169356300 ). Ignored when Team ID or Project ID is provided. Can be combined with Search query to narrow results.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team ID
input.hint: Return boards for this team. When provided, Search query and Owner are ignored.

input.name: project_id
input.label: Project ID
input.hint: Return boards in this project (Space). When provided, Search query and Owner are ignored.

input.name: sort
input.label: Sort by
input.hint: Sort order for the returned boards. Defaults to last modified .

properties.name: limit
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 20 when not provided. Maximum 50.

properties.name: offset
properties.label: Offset
properties.hint: Number of results to skip. Copy from a previous response to fetch the next page.

properties.name: inviteToAccountAndBoardLinkAccess
properties.label: Invite to account and board link access
